title: Resolve RAND headquarters continuity and current public roster coverage
summary: Recover dated authoritative evidence for RAND headquarters continuity at 1776 Main Street and improve the July public-roster capture without conflating headquarters, mailing address, offices, or subsidiary locations.

data.target: RAND headquarters continuity and current public-roster recovery
data.query: RAND Corporation 1776 Main Street headquarters annual report legal filing leadership directory roster
data.research_question: What authoritative dated records establish the continuity or change history of RAND headquarters at 1776 Main Street, and what current official roster surface can replace the July no-parseable-roster result?
objectives: Recover current and historical RAND annual-report, legal, tax, or archive evidence for explicit headquarters semantics and effective dates
Keep headquarters, physical delivery, standard-mail, office, RAND Europe, RAND Australia, and other location semantics separate
Recover a parseable current first-party leadership or people roster and preserve exact role/status dates
preferred_sources: RAND Corporation contact, leadership, annual reports, and corporate archives
IRS Form 990 or authoritative nonprofit filings
selection_reason: Current RAND dataset manifest reports no parseable public roster entries
The current first-party contact page provides unusually explicit headquarters semantics suitable for temporal follow-up
A dated authoritative continuity record would distinguish current headquarters from mailing and office addresses
